title: Battle event: How to use skill before playing out the whole page?

posts.author: Madre_Joshua
posts.body:
I am currently working on a cutscene in which a character reveals themselves to another as an assassin, stabs them, and then escapes. This is intended to be displayed by the battle processing beginning, this exchange of two lines of dialogue playing, followed by said assassin then stabbing the first character (See the skill), the character taking almost lethal damage and then the battle being interrupted and the game going back to the field after 2 seconds of waiting so the player can process what just happened. This is what I've written for it.
Unfortunately, I have run into the issue here that this will always play out the entire page before the assassin is allowed to actually use the skill in question. The second line of dialogue plays, followed by the battle simply getting aborted without the assassin ever actually attacking the main character. I've tried to rewrite this in a few ways (like having the abort battle on the second page, triggered by the cutscene switch, but that also results in the second page being played before the action takes place) and I am really not sure how I can manage to get this to actually happen. How do I make it so that she attacks him before the actual battle even starts and then have the battle be aborted without the player ever being allowed to take an action?

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body: Are you using VisuStella? They put your force actions in a queue. But then you can do it with action sequences right?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
if you don't want to0 use plugins it can be done without, but it will cost you a skill slot and a switch.
Make a copy of the skill used in force action, and in that skill add an unused switch ON into the damage formula before the damage itself (you can find the javascript code in the pinned topic for script equivalent of event commands for MZ).
then use two troop events, with the second one conditioned on the switch that is used in the skill.
this should do it because the second switch is turned by the skill use itself.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
Since you're making it like a cutscene, you don't need to do it through a skill. Put the commands in the troop event, that move, animation and then use MECH: HP, MP, TP to change the hp and show the damage popup.
Text "Die!"
MOVE: Move To Targets: enemy index 0 / actor ID 1
ANIM: Show Animation: actor ID 1
MECH: HP, MP, TP: actor ID 1 / HP Flat -100, Damage Popup? = true
Wait: 60 frames
Abort Battle
If you want to make action sequences for your skills in general, you put a notetag on the skill and attach a common event to it where it reads the sequence. It's all in the plugin instructions.
EDIT: oh, and when using the skill action sequences, you do the skill effect with MECH: Action Effect
